title: INDIA bloc announces protest in Delhi over voting rights
seoTitle: Delhi INDIA bloc protest over voting rights

tea.why: Protesters are demonstrating against alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and the Chief Election Commissioner.
tea.want: Demonstrators demand free and fair electoral processes and systems.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Congress announced the INDIA bloc will hold a major protest in Delhi on Monday, October 12, to safeguard voting rights.

summary: The opposition INDIA bloc has announced a major protest in New Delhi scheduled for Monday, October 12, to safeguard people's voting rights. Congress general secretary KC Venugopal stated that the agitation will continue until the electoral process becomes free and fair. The planned demonstration follows allegations of irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, with reports of over 13 crore deleted names, and scrutiny facing Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Ahead of the planned protest, police cracked down on demonstrators in the capital, detaining notable figures such as TMC chief Mamata Banerjee, AAP convenor Arvind Kejriwal, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke, and YouTuber Dhruv Rathee. Additionally, authorities instituted security restrictions including the closure of 45 metro stations.
demands: Make the electoral process and system free and fair
response: According to the sources, police launched a crackdown in Delhi, detaining several leaders including Mamata Banerjee, Arvind Kejriwal, Abhijeet Dipke, and Dhruv Rathee. Authorities also closed 45 metro stations.

updates.text: Congress announced that the INDIA bloc will stage a major protest in Delhi on October 12 over voting rights.
